captureConfirm.title: Turn on full answer capture?
captureConfirm.description: Every answer of every participant will be kept, with their nickname: that is personal data (GDPR — inform the participants, purge afterwards). Session archives also get much heavier in the database. Reserve it for individual tracking (assessment, certification).

chromiumOnly: This page is built for Chrome, Edge or another Chromium browser. In this browser, uploading and playing videos and sounds may not work well.
